description: This Java source file defines an abstract class 'GenericMapCollection' that implements the Collection interface, providing a generic wrapper around a Map with collection-like behaviors and custom iterator handling.

classes.name: GenericMapCollection
classes.description: An abstract class providing a collection interface over a Map, with custom iterator handling and collection operations.

methods.name: containsAll
methods.description: Checks if all elements in a collection are contained.

methods.name: isEmpty
methods.description: Checks if the underlying Map is empty.

methods.name: iterator
methods.description: Returns an iterator over the collection.

methods.name: removeAll
methods.description: Removes all elements in the given collection from this collection.

methods.name: retainAll
methods.description: Retains only elements in this collection that are contained in the specified collection.

methods.name: size
methods.description: Returns the size of the underlying Map.

methods.name: toArray
methods.description: Returns an array containing all elements.

methods.name: toArray(T[])
methods.description: Returns an array containing all elements, in the specified array type.

methods.name: appendTo
methods.description: Builds a string representation of the collection.
